title: Review action
responsibility: Perform review-status changes from the application through the existing typed write path — lock, fresh read inside the lock, atomic write — reusing `lib/tools/review-status.mjs` rather than reimplementing it, and reaching it through the server adapter layer.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ IT IS THE FIRST LOCKING CAPABILITY THE ADAPTER MUST EXPOSE, and DEC-0021 holds locking modules back for individual review precisely so this one is examined rather than arriving as a line in an adapter. A Server Component may run concurrently in ways a CLI never does. ⚠️ `reviewStatus` ONLY. #82's two-axis split is doing work here: review progress is the application's to change and `lifecycle` is not, and a single `status` field would have let this endpoint retire an artifact by accident. ⚠️ OUTSIDE ITS BOUNDARY: it does not decide whether a status change is allowed — the typed tool owns that, and one implementation serves both the CLI and the app (#47).
